about: Shared expectations for dates said as dates: 'M/D/YYYY' and 'M/D/YY' month first (day first only when the first number can't be a month: '31/12/1999' the thirty first of December), ISO '2026-11-06', 'Nov. 6' / 'November 6th, 2026' with the day as an ordinal, 'on 12/25' after a date word; fractions ('3/4 mile', 'by 1/2 tank'), versions ('1/2/3'), counts ('May 3 cars') and impossible days ('2/30') are left for the number passes. Two-digit years: under 50 are 20xx. Backseat Driver: backseat::pronunciation::ForSpeech / Dates (libs/backseat/backseat_tests/spoken_dates.json). EpubToM4B can port the rule; keep both copies in sync.
